get.description: Gets a list of all card terminals that are currently connected. This can be filtered by currency, capabilities and status.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter the response to only available or only busy terminals.

parameters.name: capabilities
parameters.description: Filter the response to only terminals with particular capabilities. This should be a comma separated list of values.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Filter the response to only terminals in a particular currency.

delete.description: Deletes/Closes a table. This removes the table from Connect and means it is no longer accessible from any endpoints. It is intended for use when a table is fully paid and closed on the EPoS and allows the same tableName to be reused. The lastKnownAmount and lastKnownPaidAmount must be passed in to ensure that deletions only take place when the EPoS has the latest table data. This is to help avoid scenarios where a table has been updated by a card terminal and the update has not yet been picked up by the EPoS.

401.description: Authorization credentials must be provided in the request headers.
The provided authorization credentials were not correct.

422.description: Incorrect JSON received.
lastKnownAmount does not match the stored amount.
lastKnownPaidAmount does not match the stored amount.

tpi.description: Terminal Public Identifier, a unique identifier assigned to this terminal.

status.description: Current status of the terminal, indicating whether it is ready to accept requests.

currency.description: Currency in which the terminal is setup. The textual representation from ISO 4217 is used.

capabilities.description: Defines the actions that this terminal is capable of performing. This field is due to be deprecated in the next API version (v2).

location.description: URI where information about this terminal can be found.

totalAmount.description: Total amount that has been taken in the current session.

totalRefundsAmount.description: Total amount of refunds (in pence) that have been taken in the current session.

totalRefundsCount.description: Total number of refunds that have taken place in the current session.

totalSalesAmount.description: Total amount of sales (in pence) that have been taken in the current session.

totalSalesCount.description: Total number of sales that have taken place in the current session.

amountBase.description: Base amount of the transaction (in pence), without cashback or gratuity.

amountCashback.description: Amount of cashback (in pence) added to the transaction.

amountGratuity.description: Amount of gratuity (in pence) added to the transaction.

amountTotal.description: Sum of amountBase, amountCashback and amountGratuity (in pence).

applicationId.description: Identifier of the application in the card used in the transaction.

applicationLabel.description: Name of the application in the card used in the transaction.

authCode.description: Authorisation code provided by the bank to approve the transaction.

cardSchemeName.description: Scheme of the card used in the transaction. The scheme controls the operation of payment transactions.

cardHolderVerificationMethod.description: Method used to verify that the person presenting the card is the legitimate cardholder.

currency.description: Currency in which the transaction took place. The textual representation from ISO 4217 is used.

dateOfExpiry.description: Expiry date of the card used in the transaction.

dateOfStart.description: Start date of the card used in the transaction.

location.description: URI where information about this transaction can be found.

notifications.description: Notifications indicating the progress of the transaction.

paymentMethod.description: Method by which the card details have been read from the payment medium.

primaryAccountNumber.description: PAN (Primary Account Number) of the card used in the transaction. Only the last 4 digits of the number are provided.

primaryAccountNumberSequence.description: Sequence number of the PAN of the card used in the transaction. Used to differentiate cards with the same PAN.

receiptLines.description: Card machine receipt(s) for the transaction.

requestId.description: UUID for this request, which can be used in other endpoints.

transactionId.description: Used by the terminal to identify this transaction.

transactionNumber.description: Number of the transaction within the current terminal session.

transactionTime.description: Time at which the transaction took place.

amount.description: Base amount of the transaction (in pence).

waiterTotals.description: A dictionary of totals split by waiter. {waiterId} is an example key.
